description: Heyyy, I like to eat tables
summary: Our game is about surviving in Mars while sustaining your hunger and thirst and also having to look out for solar flare alerts, it addresses the challenge because you can know how to survive on Mars and its important because you'll know how to live on Mars.
details: Move by using the WASD keys or arrow keys, you can enter a greenhouse in order to harvest crops and eat them and you can also drink from a water pump. We've used Scratch to code this project and I believe it's creative because I came up with the idea myself.
